newsitem.title: ITALY: Dead feared as Italian train derails.
newsitem.headline: Dead feared as Italian train derails.

text.p: A Milan-Rome express train derailed on Sunday near the station at the northern city of Piacenza and Italian media reported that a number of people were feared dead.
Italian state television said four people were believed to have died.
The Italian news agency Ansa said the train was a Pendolino, a highly popular fast train that makes the run between Italy's two most important cities in just over four hours.
The report said a number of the train's carriages were derailed and tens of ambulances and rescue vehicles were converging on the scene.
The agency said former Italian president Francesco Cossiga was aboard the train but escaped unhurt.
